equisatisfiability_theorem.conclusion: The order-144 quotient is satisfiable iff the full iteration-199 base family is satisfiable. A future proof-producing UNSAT result therefore covers the full frozen iteration-199 family encoded by the base, subject to the soundness scope of its exclusion registries.
equisatisfiability_theorem.forward: A quotient model projects to a base model because the base CNF is a byte-exact prefix.
equisatisfiability_theorem.hypotheses: The checked base semantics are invariant under every group generator: concrete Gross geometry under translations and D; order-block and selector registries are closed under both generators; the compiled base CNF exactly represents those semantics.
equisatisfiability_theorem.reverse: For any base schedule S, choose a lexicographically least time vector in its finite 144-image orbit. Invariance makes it a base schedule. It is <= every group image and the exact recurrence has one satisfying extension for each of the 143 comparisons.
equisatisfiability_theorem.stabilizers: Non-strict <= permits equal images. No freeness or orbit-size-144 assumption is used.
